campaign.title: Rename G40_16_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_16_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_16_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_16_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 75) THEN
    G40_16_PROVIDER = 75
  END IF
  G40_16_PROVIDER = G40_16_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_16_PRED_1(X)
  G40_16_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_16_PROVIDER(X) >= 13) THEN
    G40_16_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_16_PRED_1 = G40_16_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_16_PRED_2(X)
  G40_16_PRED_2 = 0
  IF (G40_16_PROVIDER(X) >= 43) THEN
    G40_16_PRED_2 = 1
  END IF
  G40_16_PRED_2 = G40_16_PRED_2
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_16_PRED_3(X)
  G40_16_PRED_3 = 0
  IF (G40_16_PRED_1(X) >= 50) THEN
    G40_16_PRED_3 = 1
  END IF
  G40_16_PRED_3 = G40_16_PRED_3
END FUNCTION
